notes.title: Release Next Week!
notes.notes:
Heroes Against Time releases next week!

I'm excited for players to discover all of the new stuff I've added to the game, including the new sets, maps, tiles, relics, enemies and palettes!!!

I hope you're as excited as I am :D
-David

notes.title: Progress Update | Releasing on the 18th!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600771/94f0f3b6b1e15003d96f0054f44919ee864a2b6d.png

New Content
I've been working hard on the new content for the game over the last few months - it includes two brand new sets of events and characters with their own unique abilities, new relics, and some new tiles with fun mechanics to spice up your runs!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600771/1d7f9cebf8c739209bb2dd2dc1bbe5a86ef90cb3.png

I've also been working on some new maps, each with their own gimmick and enemies to make things more difficult and interesting...!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600771/e14bdc7ba8938c2ff6e44354ebad47fb3e691acc.png


Delaying Release a tiny bit

As some of you might have noticed, I delayed the release of the game a couple of times throughout development due to unexpected events;

Originally, I wanted to release on August 5th! But then a war happened where I live, and I had a tough time maintaining the same pace of progress due to being woken up by sirens in the middle of the night.

So I figured I'd delay to the 28th of August... up until a few days ago!

The game is already a ton of fun, but I realized there's still some last second fixes and additions to make it the experience it should be, and that'd be better for the game if I release it calmly after everything is fixed instead of anxiously rushing to get everything ready on the last second (and breaking the game in the process!).

So I'm currently aiming to release on the 18th of September, in a few weeks from now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600771/e00bd8e14492edfbdf938c2df8b25de23daa781a.png

I hope you're as excited for Heroes Against Time's launch as I am. 
Thank you for reading!

-David

notes.title: Demo Update: Small improvements
notes.notes:
Added a sound for unlocking a new character
Added a flashing animation for the "flee" button to prompt players who are about to die in combat to escape instead
Fixed error that broke localization for players who achieved 100% completion of the Hero set

notes.title: Demo Update: Improved controller support
notes.notes: Players should now be able to easily and smoothly switch between controller and Mouse & Keyboard at any point in the game! I hope this addition helps players with controllers to have a smoother, better experience.

notes.title: Demo Update: Extended music tracks
notes.notes:
Extended in-game track

Updated main menu track

Both tracks were created by Tieff

Please let us know how you feel about these new changes!

notes.title: Demo Update: Controller fixes
notes.notes:
Improved controller connection / disconnection in the main menu

Improved controller not displaying over victory screen

notes.title: Demo Update: No rejected ally repeat, sounds and more
notes.notes:
Made it so rejected characters don't appear in the next ally tile

Improved main menu and pause menu sound effects

Controller automatically refocuses now when window is refocused, automatic controller detection on start

Other small fixes and improvements

notes.title: Demo Update: More fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
Improved Japanese and Spanish text
Made text easier to read with Before Dawn palette
Improved scrolling for runs and palettes
Added a discord link in the palette screen
Improved button behavior


More improvements tomorrow !
